---
title: "validationConfig_SCI_REMIND"
output: html_document
---

Configuration file for scenario evaluation based on the criteria of the
Scenario Compass Initiative (version 2026.8.3), using REMIND variable names.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(readr)
library(DT)

# Load the CSV from inst/config
df <- piamValidation::getConfig("SCI_REMIND_2026.8.3")

# drop columns that are empty in this config
empty_cols <- names(df)[colSums(!is.na(df)) == 0]
df <- df[, colSums(!is.na(df)) > 0, drop = FALSE]

if (length(empty_cols) > 0) {
  cat("*Columns that are empty in this config and therefore not shown:*",
      paste0("`", empty_cols, "`", collapse = ", "))
}

DT::datatable(
  df,
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "220px", targets = which(names(df) == "variable") - 1)
    )
  )
)

```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* let the config table use the full browser width (pkgdown pages only) */
.container.template-article {
  max-width: 95vw;
}
.container.template-article main.col-md-9 {

}

}
```
